messages:
Micah: quick sync — I want to propose a telemetry payload contract for the GPU pools. Goal: send SM occupancy, per-GPU memory_used_bytes, queue_depth, and available_slots for both Hosted and Dedicated. This will drive the new console dashboards + routing headroom logic.

Rachel: +1. We should include p50/p90/p99 for queue wait time if possible. Ops wants percentiles for alerts. :thumbsup:

Arjun: agree on fields. A couple of constraints from runtime: we try to keep metrics low-cardinality and sample at 10s or 30s. Suggest naming + labels like: 

```
metric_name: redwood_gpu_sm_occupancy_ratio
labels: [pool, region, host, gpu_index, model_variant, tenant_id?]
type: GAUGE
unit: ratio
sample_secs: 10
aggregation: avg, p90
```

We probably should make tenant_id optional and only sent at pool-level to avoid cardinality explosion.

Sasha: big +1 on optional tenant_id. For Dedicated we need tenant-level drilldowns, but for Hosted we should only expose tenant when the customer opts into detailed telemetry (privacy/PII). Also: prefer histogram buckets for queue_depth so console can show distribution without storing every sample.

Zoe: Console needs 1m and 5m rollups, ability to filter by pool and by "capacity tier" (hosted/dedicated), and an annotation stream for rollouts/fallbacks. Also need a field for `backfillable_slots` vs `available_slots` so UX shows true headroom.

Arjun: implementation note — runtime can emit two metrics: `redwood_gpu_available_slots` (int) and `redwood_gpu_backfillable_slots` (int). Routing policy will pick the larger of the two when deciding where to route. Those are cheap to compute.

micah: putting a small proto draft here for the telemetry-kafka topic (v1):

```
message GpuPoolTelemetryV1 {
  string pool = 1; // 'hosted-us-east-1-small'
  string region = 2;
  repeated GpuSample gpus = 3;
  int64 timestamp_ms = 4;
}
message GpuSample {
  int32 gpu_index = 1;
  double sm_occupancy_ratio = 2;
  int64 memory_used_bytes = 3;
  int32 queue_depth = 4;
  int32 available_slots = 5;
  int32 backfillable_slots = 6;
}
```

Arjun: that looks good. One ask: include a `schema_version` field at top-level so consumers can evolve smoothly. Telemetry pipeline prefers Avro/Schema Registry — we should register this before we push.

telemetry-bot: registered schema 'redwood.gpu_pool.telemetry.v1' in registry-prod (id=18237). Please ensure producers include `schema_id` header.

Rachel: routing/quotas note — model routing needs `available_slots` at pool granularity, but quota UI needs total_allocated_slots and per-tenant committed slots. Can runtime emit `total_slot_count` and `committed_slots_by_tenant` (committed only for Dedicated)? Concerned about per-tenant list size.

Sasha: for committed slots we can emit an aggregated number per tenant only for Dedicated via a separate aggregated payload (once per minute) to avoid high cardinality. Hosted will only expose `reserved_capacity_flag` and not per-tenant counts.

micah: rollout plan proposal:
- phase 1 (2 weeks): runtime emit v1 to telemetry-kafka with pool-level metrics (no tenant ids), console add read-only drafts for Hosted pools; telemetry consumers validate schema.
- phase 2 (2-3 weeks): enable Dedicated tenant-level aggregates behind a feature flag; add console drilldowns + alerts (p90 queue wait).
- phase 3: routing team flip flag to use `available_slots` for fallback decisions, monitor via canary dashboards.

Arjun: sync note — we'll need a backfill plan for the last 7d of metrics for teams building models. I'll create a small job to ingest existing Prometheus samples and populate the new topic for historical charts.

Zoe: UX followups: can we get example queries for the new dashboard panels? Prefer PromQL-like expressions and a mapping table from telemetry fields -> console panel. I'll make a ticket.

Sasha: action items: 
1) Arjun register schema + push first test message (by EOD tomorrow)
2) Micah add rollout FF + dashboard placeholders (this week)
3) Zoe write console query mappings (PR next Tue)
4) Rachel coordinate routing team for fallback logic (sync Thu)

micah: thanks all. if anyone sees a hard blocker (cardinality, privacy, event size) speak up now. otherwise we move forward. :rocket:
